name: m5-symfinal-typer-kperf
description: Where does [retronym/scala#201](https://github.com/retronym/scala/pull/201)'s gain land when compiling the scala corpus through typer only? Cycles and instructions by method from kperf, on the same builds as `m5-symfinal-typer-ipc`, whose scores should be read for timing because this profiles every fork. `aa` is a second build of `base`, for the noise in the profile diff.

variantDescriptions.symfinal: retronym/scala#201 at `4636892ff7`: the three source commits, with the `val`, plus MiMa filters and tests
variantDescriptions.stranded: `typeparam` plus the `typeParams` `rawInfo` fast path, `applyFast`, `mapConserveTypes` and the static `SubstMap` branches, all that #201 left out of #199's source (`a9f86b326b`)
